text:
maya: Heads up, Prometheus remote_write is getting hammered right now, write errors and timeouts from the receiver. Grafana shows active series shot up from ~8M -> ~24M in ~10m. Remote_write queue is filling.
ryan: seeing same. alert: prometheus_remote_write_errors firing. logs show repeated 'context deadline exceeded' and some 'upstream closed connection' traces.
alex: any recent deploys that touch metrics or sidecars?
tia: rolled out a sidecar update to inference-service yesterday that added a set of extra pod labels for tracing (user_id, session_id). Might be the culprit.
maya: timeline matches. the cardinality spike lines up with the rollout at 11:02.
sam: if it's per-user labels on pods we need to drop them at scrape level ASAP. we should relabel to drop user_id/session_id from metrics.
ryan: agree. I can push a hotfix to prometheus relabel_configs on the scrape job for k8s-sd and sidecar targets to drop those labels.
prom-bot: deploy-bot queued config-change for prometheus: prometheus-prod/patch-725 -> awaiting approval.
maya: before we patch, what's the cheapest immediate mitigation? throttle remote_write, increase queue? Cost concerns are high if downstream gets charged by ingested series.
sam: cheap/fast: add relabel_configs to drop labels, then restart reload (no restart) so reloadable config applies. Also scale remote_write receiver horizontally if possible as fallback.
ryan: here's the relabel snippet I'm about to apply: 
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_user_id", "__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_session_id"]
    action: labeldrop
    regex: "user_id|session_id"
  - source_labels: ["pod"]
    target_label: "instance"
```
alex: small nit: for labeldrop the field is 'regex' that matches label names on scraped metrics, but when using k8s service discovery labels the source_labels won't map as expected. better to use metric relabeling: 
```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
  - regex: ".*"
    source_labels: ["pod_label_user_id"]
    action: replace
    replacement: ""
    target_label: "pod_label_user_id"
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: "pod_label_user_id|pod_label_session_id|user_id|session_id"
```
riact: (typo, ignore)
tia: can we drop all labels matching the pattern 'user_id' to be safe? some apps use different prefixes.
ryan: I'll do labeldrop with regex '.*user_id.*|.*session_id.*' for metric relabel. patching now.
prom-bot: config-change applied, prometheus reloaded (config hash 9f3a2), scrape jobs reloaded.
maya: monitoring now. initial effect: series count flattening, remote_write errors dropping.
sam: check remote_write queue depth and sent samples rate.
alex: remote_write queue depth back to normal after ~40s. sent samples/sec reduced by ~65%.
tia: verified in Grafana: total_series dropped from 24M -> 9M over 2m. latency SLO for inference unaffected, but alert noise was bad.
ryan: filing a post-incident follow-up. action items: (1) revert sidecar metric change in app or namespace metrics scrub, (2) add unit test in SD job to fail deploys that add high-card labels, (3) tune alerts for remote_write_errors to include sustained error rate >5m, (4) add a dashboard panel for series-by-scrape-job and top cardinality contributors.
maya: also add billing guard: threshold alert when series_count increases >2x in 10m for a tenant or scrape job.
sam: long term: instrument exporter libs to prevent user-scoped labels and add linter for metrics.
alex: question: did this affect any paging? infra-oncall, did paging fire for oncall?
infra-oncall: yes, but we suppressed flapping alerts after we saw the relabel patch be applied. escalation kept minimal. no pager fatigue.
maya: cost hit estimate? rough numbers from the receiver team: spike would have added ~0.6 TB/day and about ~$1.8k/day in egress/ingest if left unchecked.
tia: ouch. good catch.
prom-bot: alert cleared: prometheus_remote_write_errors.
ryan: I'll open a PR to add metric relabeling to the sidecar Helm chart to automatically drop user-scoped labels and add a chart value to opt-in if needed.
sam: also schedule a retro tomorrow 10:00 to sync with app teams and infra.
maya: closing once retro scheduled. thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:
